offers.title: Agent Integration & MCP Pilot
offers.customer_problem: An enterprise has an approved integration need for an AI agent and existing APIs.
deliverables: Read-only integration feasibility and API permission matrix
One scoped agent/MCP integration proof of concept using authorized test data
Reproducible integration tests and technical runbook
acceptance: Client approves written scope and commercial terms before build
At least one documented authorized end-to-end test
Unauthorized actions and secrets are excluded from evidence
Client reviews and accepts measurable deliverables

commercial.pricing_rule: Quoted after scope; no binding public price
commercial.billing: By individually signed agreement; no automatic payment

offers.title: Robotics & AI Dataset Integrity Audit
offers.customer_problem: A dataset owner needs format, metadata and integrity checks before using robotics data.
deliverables: Small, bounded, authorized dataset manifest validation
acceptance: A test dataset is authorized for analysis
Exact supported formats are confirmed in a demo before contract
No rehosting or redistribution of third-party data without rights
Client agrees to dataset volume, scope, price and acceptance criteria

commercial.pricing_rule: Pilot quotation only after technical demonstration

anti_claims: no actual API integration before credentials and validation
